APP-0002.cover_letter_text:
I'm applying for the Senior Business Analyst role at Sysco, found through BuiltIn.

I'm a reporting and data professional with three years of experience, including close to two years in data management, CRM-based reporting and ERP environments, based in Colombo, Sri Lanka.

At SHAA Enterprises, I worked as a reporting business partner to sales and operations teams, extracting and transforming data from the Ventura CRM system into structured reports on sales, inventory and receivables, and answering data-related queries for management meetings. At IFS, I supported enterprise ERP data workflows and ran QA/QC checks to keep reporting accurate and compliant across business processes. My BSc (Hons) in Data Science and Higher Diploma in Computing & Software Engineering, both from Cardiff Metropolitan University, sit behind this.

I don't have a formal Business Analyst title or hands-on SQL yet, but the stakeholder communication, data validation and cross-functional coordination side of the role match closely with what I've actually done. Sysco's work on enterprise-grade technology across sourcing, logistics and pricing is the kind of B2B, enterprise-systems space I want to keep working in.

I'm available immediately and can work remotely from Sri Lanka. My resume is attached.

Best regards,
Ameerul Athallah
